lines: It comes in from the north, it goes out to the south, and I make it louder.
I do not read it. It is not in words, it is in gaps, and the gaps are somebody else's.
Whoever is at the far end of this knows things before the people they are about do.
Relay six. I keep the batteries topped and the tape running and that is all of it.
Quietest posting in Caelora. That is not an accident, it is a requirement.
